items.title: Eddie Miller and Pete Fountain Interview, 1970-01-09
items.q: The interviewer mentions Jerry Mulligan talking about rearranging ragtime tunes; the interviewee does not respond with any personal connection or interaction with Mulligan.

ctx.x: Thank you. You know, that's something that Jerry Mulligan talked about when he was down here. He'd like to take some of those old ragtime tunes and rearrange them for the ten-piece bands that he sometimes records with. I think there'd be a market for that kind of thing. I think he'd get into the bank. Yeah. Hello, go ahead, please.
I was wondering if I understood right if Pete was making it, recording a new record album, and I wondered when it would be out and if he had a name for it.
